sector_setup: canonical first-sector vertices p_n=(a_n,b_n), n=0..M_N(r), with p_0=(r,0), p_M=(0,r)
center_consistency: when a_n=b_n both identities hold simultaneously; if the central turn crosses the bisector without a bisector vertex, the two one-sided conventions differ only on that single edge
proof_left: before the bisector every legal symbol is 1:(a,b)->(a,b+1) or 2:(a,b)->(a-1,b+1), so b increases by exactly one on every turn
proof_right: after the bisector every legal symbol is 2:(a,b)->(a-1,b+1) or 3:(a,b)->(a-1,b), so a decreases by exactly one on every turn; exactly a turns remain to (0,r)
target_native: all identities follow from the frozen AK turn alphabet and monotone target path; source angle or arc length is not used
consequence_for_continuum: after division by r, the cumulative turn count is controlled directly by b/r on the left and M_N(r)/r-a/r on the right
